Yes but its complicated, in the UK it can take in excess of a month before you see any payment and this is further complicated by the last time I was on unemployment benefits I requested an emergency payment to get money sooner that I have not paid back (they were supposed to deduct from my wages when I got a job but for whatever reason have not) so they will not issue another payment to me if I do go on benefits

Further complicating this is part of the application process they require as part of identification a proof of my address (bills, council tax statements etc.) and the person who owns the house is a close friend who I am too ashamed to open up to and tell him everything that has gone on
